high_level_description: The image features a Google Doodle celebrating the popular Indian breakfast dish, idli. The main focus is on a plate of idlis served with a bowl of sambar, a common accompaniment for idlis. The idlis are neatly arranged around the bowl of sambar, which contains a rich, orange-colored lentil-based curry. In the background, there is a decorative arrangement of flowers, adding a festive and vibrant touch to the scene. The flowers appear to be artificial and are placed on a dark surface, possibly a table or countertop. On the left side of the image, there is a Google Doodle itself.
